caption: The video captures an outdoor garden scene where a large pile of dry branches and leaves is already burning. A red-tiled structure with a small pale chimney sits behind the pile, with green grass and shrubs beyond. To the right, a separate blackened, charred mound carries its own smaller flames. Across the clip the flames flicker and reshape continuously, the central column varying in height and spread. The small flames on the right-hand mound wax and wane, lifting into a taller tongue at one point. Pale smoke rises from the center, drifting upward and slightly right and thickening toward the later frames. The unburned pile and charred mound keep the same outline, so change lies in the fire and smoke.
relations: Central flames flicker and reshape continuously, varying in height and spread over the burning pile.
Pale smoke rises from the center, drifting upward and slightly right, thickening toward later frames.
Smaller flames on the right charred mound wax and wane, lifting into taller tongues.
The unburned pile and charred mound keep their outlines, limiting change to fire and smoke.
